profile.headline: Full-stack Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Hey, I'm Jordan, a dedicated full-stack software engineer with in-depth knowledge of technologies such as React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Node. This has allowed me to develop and test impactful features that enhance engagement and workflow efficiency. Committed to staying at the forefront of emerging tech, I continuously expand my skill set to deliver intuitive web solutions. With a collaborative work ethic and a passion for innovation, I’m driven to create seamless experiences for users.

I'm passionate about software, gaming, sports (even e-sports), and expressing myself creatively. If you'd like to learn more about me, talk about the universe, or anything else, feel free to reach out via LinkedIn or email.

Core Competencies:

Agile Methodology | AWS | C++ | CircleCI | CSS | Data structures and Algorithms | Docker | End 2 End Testing | Express | Flagship | Git | GitHub | GitHub Actions | GitLab | HTML | JavaScript | Jest | Kubernetes | MUI | Next.js | Node | Postgres | Postman | React | React Testing Library | Sass | Sequelize | Software Development Process | Tailwind | Typescript | Unit Testing | Written and Verbal Communication

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: As a Contract Software Engineer at Know Your Developer, I contributed to building a cutting-edge talent assessment platform powered by LLM technology. My role involved designing an AI-skills detection pipeline and re-architecting AI coaching prompts to deliver evidence-based recommendations. I also integrated Microsoft Entra ID SSO for improved user authentication

positions.title: Owner and Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
• Co-leading a business that provides students with a faster and more streamlined way to prep for registration.
• Developed the automation of school and course information using Selenium, Kotlin, and Jenkins.
• Designed, tested, and created the ui/ux for ScheduleLab on both iOS and Android following their respective design specs
• Built and designed the current ScheduleLab and "try ScheduleLab" websites using React.
• Communicated and built relationships with various school CTOs to promote ScheduleLab to their students

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
Built a communication platform for project managers and subcontractors
Built a quoting tool that allows a customer to receive an automatic paint quote via online user flow
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · SST · Next.js · MongoDB · Docker · Tailwind CSS

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Reviewed and developed unit tests while utilizing test driven development to improve software quality and reliability.
• Implemented a feature that improved veterinarian workflow during patient testing phases, resulting in a 10 - 15% decrease in time taken to complete the swab workflow.
• Conducted full lifecycle software development from planning to deployment and maintenance.
• Acted as "ceremony leader" multiple times. This involved running standup, post-standup meetings, grooming, and acting as retro leader.
• Collaborated with the PM to develop an EPIC which involved creating tickets that had acceptance criteria, detailed descriptions, and provided the PM with feedback for scope/detail changes.
positions.insights: Skills: User Requirements · Technical Leadership · Front-End Development · Analytical Skills · Express.js · Agile Development · Problem Solving · Programming Languages · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Software Development · Material-UI · Test Scenarios · TypeScript · API Documentation · Code Review · Databases · Back-End Web Development · Node.js · Full-Stack Development · Communication · Programming · Computer Science · React.js

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Created a web app utilizing Node.Js for API calls to store multi-modal drone classification data into a PostgreSQL database while utilizing Sequelize, Vue.JS

• Developed a web app using React, React Redux, NatNet SDK and D3. The application graphed live OptiTrack data of a single drone flying in the lab’s anechoic chamber

• Worked on developing a communication proxy between a platform simulator and GRPC based drone detection application while utilizing RPC and JeroMq to streamline sensor addition 

• Planned and lead a virtual event for Burlington High students to learn about drones, and the work done at KRI
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · Analytical Skills · Problem Solving · Programming Languages · Software Development · Test Scenarios · Code Review · Databases · Communication · Programming · Computer Science

positions.title: Senior Associate Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
• Built a SaaS application while utilizing VueJS and Spring to manage and track purchases between Chewy and their vendors 

• Created an integration engine that connects multiple systems which depend on a single data source

• Developed and integrated general-purpose emailing service utilizing AWS’ SES

• Utilized latest standards and guidelines for SEO and Accessibility to optimize Chewy.com
